_comment: Locale-independent config. Copy this template dir to bavrk.com/<app>/ (scripts/new-site.sh does it), edit the values below + locales/en.json, translate the other locales/*.json, then `npm run dev`. 'en' must stay first (it is the site root and x-default). Leave appStoreId/appStoreUrl empty until the app is live: the install banner and JSON-LD installUrl are omitted while empty. featureIcons are lucide icon names (lucide.dev/icons), one per features.fN_h in the locale files; proFeature is the 1-based feature that gets the Pro badge (0 for none). proPrice/proCurrency, when set, add a Pro offer to the JSON-LD. kind is 'app' (a mobile app: iPhone hero, App Store or launch-email CTA, pricing) or 'saas' (software people run or sign up for: browser-frame hero, screenshot showcase, a docs page from src/content/docs.md, a stored/never trust section, the CTA to primaryUrl). sections, when set, overrides the kind's landing sections (steps, showcase, features, collected, pricing, faq, band). The saas-only keys: primaryUrl (the main button; a github.com URL gets the GitHub mark), githubUrl (source link, adds SoftwareSourceCode JSON-LD), license, demoUrl, browserUrl (the address shown in the frames), heroScreenDark, operatingSystem, showcase ([{light, dark, url, link}], strings in showcase.sN_h / sN_p).
tagline: Feedback and anonymous tracking for your apps
